purpose: Research screening; no automatic production promotion. Registered before extension model scores.

datasets.AMAZXA: Rice P addition with equal reported N and K, matched trial/variety; published adjusted genotype means, not replicate-level measurements. Neighboring P environments: causal assignment remains unqualified.
datasets.GFWCYQ: Rice long-term fertilizer regimes at Ndiaye; compare each treatment with contemporaneous control. Repeated treatments include legacy effects, not first-season fertilizer effects.
datasets.BBKJH0: Audit and descriptive paired management strategies only. Unit conflict and multiple management changes prevent fertilizer-only calibration.
datasets.4CFDEG: Quarantined: conflicting treatment dose, unverified moisture and suspect Ndiaye coordinates; potential shared experiment with GFWCYQ.
datasets.TROYBD: Quarantined: original pair identifiers lost in standardization, conflicting rates and country/site ambiguity; original metadata access currently HTTP 403.
datasets.SRANPI: Descriptive source inventory only: variety, gypsum, zinc and fertilizer changes confounded.

AMAZXA.outer: Leave one entire country out; all site-years and varieties in country travel together. No pooling with other datasets.
AMAZXA.inner: Leave one entire site out within remaining countries; select candidate on equally site-weighted delta MAE.
AMAZXA.uncertainty: Descriptive outer-fold residual quantiles only; no coverage guarantee or prospective confidence interval.
AMAZXA.target: P environment difference at matched genotype, t/ha grain at 14 percent moisture, from paper 10.3389/fpls.2016.01435

GFWCYQ.saturation: delta = a + b * (1-exp(-N/tau)), fit only N=60,120,180 at P=26,K=50; a captures the shared PK contrast and is not a zero-N prediction. Never extrapolate or optimize.
GFWCYQ.weighting: equal campaign, then equal treatments within campaign
GFWCYQ.uncertainty: 95 percent split conformal, calibration scores=max absolute residual within each validation year; unavailable when finite-sample quantile exceeds calibration group count.
GFWCYQ.scope: Temporal diagnostic at one repeatedly fertilized irrigated site; not geographical validation or a clean new-dose response. Moisture not qualified in supplied data.

rationale: Preserves earlier practical research thresholds; do not lower them after seeing results. A passed numerical screen alone is insufficient to activate parcel advice.
